title: In one place
caption: Sunil's CA has finished the return, and Sunil does not want to dig through WhatsApp for it. The founder tells his story.
linkedin_text: In India, if your CA is on ScoreMyBiz, the filings and returns they upload appear in one list in your app. ScoreMyBiz does not prepare or file any return; it only keeps what your CA sends you.

cast.sunil: Sunil, a middle-aged Indian garment shop owner with a moustache, in a cream kurta and a gold wristwatch

scenes.clip: the founder, a young Indian man with a short beard in a navy suit and striped tie, facing the camera outside a bustling garment shop in the afternoon, colourful fabrics hanging behind him, a warm smile.
